definition.simple: Several losing trades in a row.
definition.balanced: Losing streaks are normal, even for a plan that works over time. If each trade loses with chance L, independently, the chance the next N trades all lose is L to the power N. Over many trades, the chance of seeing some streak is much higher. Never raise size to win losses back.

example: With an example 50% loss chance, the next 5 trades all lose with chance 0.5^5 = 3.125%.
